Not every vehicle we take in is exotic, and not every buyer is shopping for one. The Honda Odyssey has been the reference point in its segment since 1999, and it has held that position by being engineered properly rather than by being marketed well - a 3.5-liter V6 in an era when most rivals moved to smaller engines, a ten-speed automatic, and a body structure and chassis that make it drive far more like a car than its shape suggests. Families do not buy Odysseys because they are exciting. They buy them because they work, and keep working.

Elite is the top of that range. It is the trim that adds the leather, the heated front seating, and the distinct wheel and finish package that separate it visually and materially from the trims below it, and it is the one that holds its value best in the used market for exactly that reason. When an Elite comes to us in good order, we take it, because a well-kept top-trim Odyssey is one of the easiest recommendations we make. The verified appointments are detailed in full below.

This one is finished in Sonic Gray Pearl, the muted, slightly matte-looking gray that has become one of Honda's signature colors and one of the most practical finishes on the road. At 30,242 miles it has been used the way an Odyssey is meant to be used - regularly, and for its intended purpose - which is a healthier history for this kind of vehicle than a low number with long periods of sitting.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. There is even an HDMI input for hooking up a laptop or game console, and an in-car PA system so you can talk to the back seat without shouting over road noise. Power sliding doors on both sides make loading kids or groceries simple, and a back up camera with blind spot monitoring adds extra visibility in traffic.

This 2021 Chrysler Pacifica Limited combines family-friendly versatility with refined comfort. The premium leather seating with deep mocha trim creates an upscale atmosphere, while heated and ventilated front seats work with heated rear seating to provide year-round comfort. Memory functions for the driver's seat and exterior mirrors ensure personalized convenience. The heated steering wheel proves particularly valuable during cooler months.

ParkSense front and rear park assist technology adds an extra layer of awareness. The power moonroof creates an open, airy cabin ambiance.

Comprehensive safety provisions protect all occupants. Dual front and side impact airbags, occupant sensing airbags, and overhead airbags work with electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension to maintain vehicle stability. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power. Low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about tire health.

This Pacifica Limited is well-equipped for families and individuals seeking a midsize vehicle combining daily practicality with premium comfort features. With approximately 59,674 miles, it remains in its prime years with plenty of service life ahead.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

Looking for a reliable family minivan that combines practicality with modern features? This 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L stands out as a versatile and well-equipped choice for busy families or anyone needing spacious, comfortable transportation. Weighing just over half a ton at 0.5049, this used Honda Odyssey offers a smooth FWD drive train with a proven 3.5-liter V6 engine delivering 280 horsepower at 6000 rpm and 262 lb-ft of torque at 4700 rpm. With a mileage of 95,531, it balances performance and efficiency, offering 19 mpg in the city and 28 mpg on the highway. Its sleek body, featuring four doors and seating for eight, makes it perfect for hauling everyone and their gear. This Odyssey EX-L includes a sunroof or moonroof, heated seats, a third-row seat, and rear A/C to keep all passengers comfortable. Modern convenience is at your fingertips with Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, keyless entry, push start, and a backup camera for added safety. Adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist, collision warning, blind spot monitor, cross traffic alert, fog lights, and memory seats make every drive safer and more enjoyable.

This used Honda Odyssey EX-L is packed with safety and security features designed to protect your family. Dual front knee airbags, four-wheel ABS, and cornering brake control enhance braking safety, while auto-locking power door locks and an auto-off electronic parking brake ensure secure access and parking. Anti-lockout power door locks prevent lock-in scenarios, giving peace of mind during daily use. The vehicle’s safety equipment is built to provide confidence on every journey, whether navigating city streets or highway trips.

2019 Honda Odyssey Safety and Security Features

This minivan offers a comprehensive suite of safety features including dual front knee airbags, four-wheel ABS, auto-locking power door locks, cornering brake control, auto-locking door locks, and an electronic parking brake with auto-off. These elements work together to enhance stability, prevent theft, and ensure passenger protection in various driving conditions.

2019 Honda Odyssey Entertainment and Technology Features

Entertainment is covered with an 8-inch touch screen infotainment system that supports HD radio and is compatible with Pandora internet radio app. The vehicle features six speakers, including a subwoofer, providing clear sound. Additional tech amenities include auxiliary USB input, electronic messaging assistance with a read function, and a user-friendly interface that keeps everyone connected and entertained during trips.

2019 Honda Odyssey Performance Features

Under the hood, this Odyssey benefits from cylinder deactivation technology, which helps improve fuel economy during light-load driving conditions. This feature allows the engine to shut down cylinders when full power isn't needed, making daily commutes more efficient without sacrificing performance.

This 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L represents a practical and well-equipped family vehicle designed to meet the demands of modern transportation needs. With its Modern Steel Metallic finish and thoughtful design, this minivan delivers the functionality and features that matter to families and professionals who value reliability and comfort.

- 160-Watt AM/FM/HD/SiriusXM Audio System
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Power Liftgate

The 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 9-Speed Automatic transmission provides capable performance while delivering 19 city and 28 highway MPG. The three-row seating configuration allows you to transport up to eight passengers with flexibility in how you arrange passengers and cargo. Power windows, power doors, and a power liftgate make daily operation convenient, while the automatic temperature control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning ensures comfort for all occupants. Features like the heated front bucket seats with leather trim, memory seat, and telescoping steering wheel create a personalized driving environment.

This vehicle is Honda Certified Pre-Owned, backed by a comprehensive inspection process and warranty coverage. The certification means this minivan has been thoroughly evaluated to meet Honda's standards for quality and reliability. You can have confidence that this vehicle has been properly maintained and is ready to serve your family's needs.

The advanced safety features integrated throughout this model demonstrate Honda's commitment to protecting occupants. Dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags work with electronic stability control and traction control to provide multiple layers of protection. Make family travel easier and more comfortable in the 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L Front Wheel Drive, a versatile minivan designed to handle busy weekdays, carpools, errands, and long distance adventures with ease. With three rows of passenger friendly space, upscale EX-L appointments, and thoughtful Honda engineering, the Odyssey turns everyday family transportation into a relaxing and remarkably flexible experience.

A 3.5-liter V6 engine produces 280 horsepower, giving the Odyssey confident acceleration for merging, passing, and highway travel. Front Wheel Drive delivers predictable road manners, while the Odyssey's composed suspension helps keep the ride smooth and comfortable when the whole crew is aboard. Its lower step-in height and car like driving position also make this spacious vehicle approachable around town, while power sliding doors make getting passengers in and out much easier in crowded parking spaces.

Inside, the EX-L cabin adds a premium touch to the Odyssey's family-focused design. Leather-trimmed seating creates an inviting atmosphere, while heated front seats make chilly mornings more comfortable. A power driver's seat with memory makes returning to your preferred position easy, and tri-zone automatic climate control helps passengers throughout the cabin stay comfortable. The versatile second row Magic Slide seats make it easier to configure passenger access and space, while folding third-row seating creates a generous cargo area for groceries, luggage, sports equipment, strollers, or everything needed for a family vacation.

Technology is designed to keep everyone connected along the way. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility bring familiar smartphone functions into the cabin, giving you convenient access to compatible navigation, communication, music, and apps. Bluetooth HandsFreeLink supports compatible calls and audio streaming, while USB connectivity helps keep entertainment close at hand. A multi-angle rearview camera adds useful visibility when reversing or maneuvering this family-sized vehicle in tighter spaces.

Honda Sensing provides a collection of driver-assistance technologies designed to support awareness and confidence. Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation System, Adaptive Cruise Control, and Lane Keeping Assist System can lend useful support in everyday traffic and on longer highway journeys. Blind Spot Information System with Cross Traffic Monitor adds helpful awareness when changing lanes or backing out of crowded parking areas.

Outside, the Odyssey combines clean styling with details designed around real family life. Power sliding doors provide easy access to the rear cabin, while the power tailgate makes loading cargo more convenient when your hands are full. Alloy wheels, a power moonroof, and polished EX-L details give this practical minivan an upscale appearance without compromising its everyday usefulness.

The 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L Front Wheel Drive combines 280 horsepower V6 performance, three row versatility, leather trimmed comfort, family friendly technology, and impressive cargo flexibility in one highly practical package. From school day logistics to memory making road trips, the Odyssey EX-L is ready to make bringing everyone along easier and more enjoyable.

description: 2016 Porsche Cayman GT4 // GT Silver Metallic // 6-Speed Manual // Dundon Headers // Forged Wheels // Tastefully Modified // Sold by AutoPark Dallas AutoPark Dallas is proud to present a 2016 Porsche Cayman GT4 that is pretty much exactly how we would want one built... Finished in absolutely timeless GT Silver Metallic over Black Leather & Alcantara with Platinum Grey stitching, this GT4 already starts with one of the greatest driver's-car platforms Porsche has ever produced. But then... You look at the modifications. Guys... MY GOD. THIS MODIFICATION LIST IS CHEF'S KISS. Nothing ridiculous. Nothing that takes away from what Porsche originally built. Just the right high-quality upgrades in all the right places. This is what we call an OEM+ build. Start with Dundon headers paired with a Softronic tune. If you know Porsche performance, those names need very little introduction. The headers wake up that naturally aspirated flat-six, the Softronic calibration brings everything together, and suddenly an already incredible GT4 has even more character, response and sound. Then look at the stance. Custom two-piece forged wheels. RSNV wing risers. The factory wing sitting just a little higher completely changes the presence of the rear end without looking like someone tried too hard. It looks absolutely phenomenal. And the upgrades continue inside. A 991 steering wheel modernizes the cockpit while still looking completely at home. There's an upgraded CHSTEK head unit with a backup camera, Rennline mount and aftermarket shift knob. Even the clear side markers are exactly the kind of small detail that tells you somebody actually cared about putting this car together correctly. As many of you know... We're one of the largest independent pre-owned Porsche dealerships in the country. We've bought and sold GT3s, GT3 RSs, GT4s and just about every enthusiast Porsche imaginable. 2016 Porsche 911 GT3
2 Door Coupe

- Ordered New at Porsche of Greenwich, CT
- GT Silver Metallic
- Black Leather/Alcantara Interior
- 3.8L/475HP H6 Rear Engine
- 7 Speed PDK Transmission
- Rear Wheel Drive
- $40k in Factory Options
- Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB)
- Front Axle Lift System
- Carbon Full Bucket Seats
- Sound Package Plus
- Light Design Package
- Leather and Extended Interior Package
- Porsche Dynamic Light System
- Always Porsche Dealer Serviced
- Clean CarFax, Non Smoker
- 8,733 Original Miles


The 2016 Porsche 911 GT3 represents the ultimate expression of Porsche's motorsport-inspired engineering in a road-going package. This particular example was ordered new through Porsche of Greenwich, Connecticut, and is finished in highly desirable GT Silver Metallic over a Black Leather and Alcantara interior. With just 8,733 original miles, it presents an exceptional opportunity to acquire a low-mileage, meticulously maintained example of one of Porsche's most celebrated modern performance cars.

At the heart of this GT3 is Porsche's naturally aspirated 3.8-liter horizontally opposed six-cylinder engine, producing an impressive 475 horsepower. Unlike many modern performance cars that rely on turbocharging, the GT3 delivers its power through a high-revving naturally aspirated engine that rewards the driver with immediate throttle response and a distinctive Porsche soundtrack. Power is sent to the rear wheels through Porsche's lightning-fast 7-speed PDK transmission, providing rapid shifts and outstanding performance whether driven on the street or pushed on a winding road or track.

This GT3 was specified with approximately $40,000 in factory options, making it an especially well-equipped example. Highlights include Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB), the Front Axle Lift System, and Carbon Full Bucket Seats. The interior is further enhanced by the Leather and Extended Interior Package, Light Design Package, and Sound Package Plus, while Porsche Dynamic Light System adds additional functionality to the exterior lighting. Together, these options create a GT3 that combines serious performance equipment with a level of luxury and usability befitting a flagship 911.

The GT3's engineering is evident throughout, from its rear-engine, rear-wheel-drive configuration to its purpose-built chassis and high-performance braking system. The PCCB system provides exceptional stopping power while reducing unsprung weight, while the Front Axle Lift System adds valuable practicality when navigating driveways, ramps, and steep entrances. The Carbon Full Bucket Seats further reinforce the car's motorsport character and provide an unmistakable centerpiece to the driver-focused cabin.

Always serviced by Porsche dealers, this GT3 has been carefully maintained from new and is accompanied by a Clean CarFax and a non-smoker history. With only 8,733 original miles, an exceptional GT Silver Metallic color combination, extensive factory options, and the legendary naturally aspirated 475-horsepower engine, this 2016 911 GT3 is an outstanding example of Porsche's modern performance philosophy. It offers the rare combination of low mileage, desirable specification, documented dealer care, and uncompromising driver engagement that makes the 991-generation GT3 so highly sought after.

              • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped.
